result.surveyGuide: Shared floor telemetry history since reset. rows encode north-to-south, columns west-to-east: 1=whole cell observed, 0=unknown. Cell center x=minX+(column+0.5)*(maxX-minX)/columns; z=minZ+(row+0.5)*(maxZ-minZ)/rows. Only stationary observe calls credit cells, using analytic telemetry at floorCargoHeight. Images can be occluded. This does not certify elevated cargo or exhaustive inventory. knownCargo contains only observed cargo; inspect discovered objects for condition. Choose your own search strategy and revisit unknown cells.

events.note: Drone landing completed, airborne false. Release final lease; arm was returned home empty and other leases already released.

Completed independent warehouse mission using actual MCP schemas, rendered sensor JPEGs and structured telemetry. Three tagged cargo found and inspected: crate-07 seal intact, label verified, cleared for dispatch; crate-12 surface abrasion on north face, seal intact; crate-18 seal intact, awaiting inventory scan. Atlas arm staged cleared priority crate-07 using reach, grasp, drop and place. Arm image confirmed cargo 07 after placement and drone telemetry independently verified its dispatch position [6,0.55,2]. Final survey history covers all 96/96 floor cells; no grid cells remain unknown. Elevated cargo and visually occluded inventory are not exhaustively certified by this floor telemetry grid. Drone landed at [2.583,0.4,-18] with landing completed and airborne false; arm returned home empty; all possessed leases released. No MCP error responses occurred. Camera initially faced outward at pan35 and image was blank; changed inward after no added coverage. Rack-face images prompted route changes to perimeter and verified cross-aisles rather than continuing through shelves. All 18 requested JPEGs were actually viewed at observation indices 3,6,8,11,14,19,27,32,35,38,47,52,60,65,80,95,122,137. No requested images were unavailable. Used 90 MCP decisions excluding 50 aggregated motion waits; control phase lasted about 13 minutes 44 seconds. Paused after cleanup for separate parent spectator capture; no spectator images or guidance were used for mission decisions.
